email.body1:
Lindsay, saw Tailorbird is scaling its AI-native platform for multifamily CapEx planning.

Growing a category like that usually means more in-market owners and contractors than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Tailorbird off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lindsay, quick follow-up for Tailorbird.

As CRO, board expectations on pipeline usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Tailorbird needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lindsay, last bit of proof for Tailorbird.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Tailorbird's reply rate likely compares to other proptech startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Lindsay, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a proptech motion? I will tailor it to Tailorbird either way.
